dca.rule.redstoneOreNoteBlockBlink.name: Redstone Ore Random Flip
dca.rule.redstoneOreNoteBlockBlink.desc: Redstone ore with a note block directly above it randomly toggles its lit state, at intervals of n~5n ticks, where n is the note block's note value.
dca.rule.villagerBulkTrade.name: Bulk Trade Blast
dca.rule.villagerBulkTrade.desc: Holding Ctrl+Alt+C in the trade screen repeats the selected trade with every inventory item that can pay for it, dropping the products.
dca.rule.chorusFlowerBonemeal.name: Chorus Flower Ripening
dca.rule.chorusFlowerBonemeal.desc: Bone meal gives one connected chorus flower a single natural growth tick.
dca.rule.pauseSoundOnFocusLost.name: Silence On Window Unfocus
dca.rule.pauseSoundOnFocusLost.desc: Silences the selected sound categories while the game window is unfocused.
dca.rule.endPlatformShapeUpdateOnEntry.d: Makes the End arrival platform emit a shape update (post-placement update) in all six directions on every arrival.
dca.rule.endPortalDestinationInEnd.name: End Portal Inside The End Enters The End
dca.rule.endPortalDestinationInEnd.desc: An end portal inside the End sends entities to the End, as if arriving from the Overworld. Beware: you can get stuck in the End!
